overview_description.description: Alluxio, Inc. (formerly Tachyon Nexus) team consists of the creators and top committers of Alluxio (formerly Tachyon), an open source project from UC Berkeley AMPLab. For the past three years, we have been working to revolutionize the way data is stored, accessed, and managed by focusing on a memory-centric architecture. We believe this new approach is key to delivering the next generation storage.

about_short_description.short_description: Alluxio is a web-scale producer that develops data orchestration for AI analytics and cloud services.

product.name: Alluxio Enterprise AI
product.description: A data orchestration platform designed to accelerate AI model training, distribution, and inference by optimizing data access to GPUs across diverse storage environments.

product.name: Alluxio Distributed Cache
product.description: A caching system that accelerates AI workloads by providing high-speed access to petabytes of data across various storage types, maximizing GPU utilization.

product.name: Alluxio Enterprise Data Editions
product.description: Software editions optimized for accelerating big data analytics workloads by providing unified data access and improving query performance across multiple storage systems.

product.name: Rapid Alluxio Deployer (RAD) on AWS
product.description: A deployment tool that enables quick installation and configuration of Alluxio Enterprise AI on AWS environments with a split-plane architecture.

product.name: Alluxio AI Acceleration Platform
product.description: A platform that leverages NVMe SSDs near GPU clusters to accelerate data access for AI workloads without replicating data or requiring additional persistent storage.
